journeyGroups.why: Why now: Emily's Engineering filter produced a bounded all-Engineering result and changed pagination, giving a concrete directory behavior to decide. Observations: #6 (Emily.dawson).

scenarios.name: Filter the employee directory by Engineering
scenarios.gherkin:
Given Emily.dawson is viewing the employee directory
When Emily.dawson selects Engineering in the department filter
Then the directory displays 8 employees and every rendered row is in Engineering
And pagination shows Page 1 of 1 with Previous and Next disabled
